testCase:
H-08: Date, time, colour and range fields
Goal: Book a stay with check-in on 20 November 2026, arrival at 14:30, room colour #336699 and 3 guests.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-08/
STEP 2: Fill "Check-in date" with "2026-11-20"
STEP 3: Fill "Arrival time" with "14:30"
STEP 4: Fill "Room colour" with "#336699"
STEP 5: Set "Guests" to 3
STEP 6: Click "Book"
STEP 7: Verify "Booked: 2026-11-20 14:30 #336699 3 guests" is visible

plan.title: H-08: Date, time, colour and range fields

steps.note: Set the guest range input to three.
Verify the booking confirmation contains all requested values.

reasoning: This test checks booking a stay using date, time, colour and guest-range inputs. The plan fills the requested values in order, submits the booking, and verifies the exact confirmation.
